sql: select case when m.close_time is null then 'unknown' when m.close_time < now() then 'market_closed' else 'still_open' end as market_state, count(*) as positions, min(p.created_at)::text as oldest, max(p.created_at)::text as newest from paper_positions p left join mmsell_settlement_meta m on m.market_ticker=p.market_ticker where p.strategy='Cmmsell10' and p.status='open' group by 1 order by 2 desc
